content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured wool-blend blazer in charcoal gray (#3d4052), tailored fit with notch lapels and a straight hem ending at the hip, paired with matching high-waisted trousers that taper slightly at the ankle. Underneath, a crisp white poplin button-down shirt with a pointed collar and long sleeves rolled casually to the elbow. Footwear consists of sleek black leather ankle boots with a low block heel and a rubber toe cap for grip on icy surfaces. Accessories include a thin gold chain necklace and a structured black leather tote bag. This outfit works because it strictly adheres to the professional dress code while providing sufficient insulation against the freezing −10 °C temperature and snowy conditions. The monochromatic dark base creates a streamlined silhouette suitable for walking briskly over potentially slippery, salted streets without looking bulky. The combination of structured outerwear and classic separates offers a polished yet practical look appropriate for a business meeting during winter."}
